name: Aluleth Kits – Elementor Starter Sites & Website Kits
author: aluleth

sections.description:
Aluleth Kits adds a gallery of starter websites to Appearance > Aluleth Kits.

  • Free kits import in one click: pages, an Elementor header or footer template, a menu, and the kit colours and fonts.
  • Elementor is installed for you from WordPress.org if it is missing (only when you click Import).
  • Nothing is overwritten: the kit adds new pages. Your existing pages stay as they are.
  • Undo: remove an imported kit from the same screen. Its pages and templates go to the Trash and your previous settings (home page, menu location, Elementor colours and fonts, theme header and footer) come back.
  • Made for the free Aluleth theme: with Aluleth, the kit header and footer settings are applied too. Kits also work with other themes.

The gallery also shows premium kits sold on Aluleth Market, with a link to their live demo and their page on the market. Buying is never required to use the free kits.

Free kits

  • Northfield Studio – a one-page site for a design and web studio: hero, services, work, process, questions and contact. Built with the free version of Elementor only.

External services

This plugin connects to Aluleth Market (market.alulethmarketing.com), a service run by the plugin author, Aluleth Corp LLC.

  • What it is used for: to show the list of kits, and to download the files of a free kit when you click Import.
  • When: the kit list is loaded when you open Appearance > Aluleth Kits (then kept for 12 hours). A kit file is downloaded only when you click Import. Kit preview images are shown from the same site.
  • What is sent: a normal web request for the list or the file. The plugin does not send your site address, your email, or any information about your site or its visitors. The server, like any web server, receives the IP address of your server or browser.
  • Terms and privacy: Terms of service, Privacy policy.

When a kit needs a plugin that is not installed (for example Elementor), the plugin is installed from WordPress.org through the standard WordPress installer.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Appearance > Aluleth Kits.
  3. Click Import on a free kit and follow the steps.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. The free kits only need the free Elementor plugin. Some premium kits on Aluleth Market need Elementor Pro; this is shown on each kit.

Do I need the Aluleth theme?

It is recommended. The kits use the Aluleth header and footer options. With another theme the pages are imported, but the header and footer depend on your theme.

Will it change my existing pages?

No. A kit only adds new pages, templates, images and a menu. If you choose it, the kit home page becomes your home page and the kit colours and fonts are applied to Elementor. You can undo this with Remove.

Does the plugin track me?

No. See “External services” above.
